name: Zhentarim Tactics

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/character-options.

summary: Reference-only: After a creature within 5 feet hits you with a melee attack, you may make an Opportunity Attack against it. After each Long Rest, choose a proficient skill to have Expertise until your next Long Rest.
